name: Highlord Demitrian
summary: Highlord Demitrian is a solitary human hermit dwelling amidst the strange crystals of northwestern Silithus. Describing himself as a loyal servant of Prince Thunderaan, he possesses the esoteric knowledge required to wake the slumbering elemental lord. Adventurers bearing ancient elemental bindings seek him out to unlock the power of the Windseeker.

sections.title: Hermit of the Crystal Vale
sections.body: Found lingering at an abandoned encampment in the Crystal Vale, Demitrian appears out of place in the desolate wastes of Silithus. Though he is tied to the Twilight's Hammer whose ravaged camp he haunts, Demitrian acts above all as a herald for Prince Thunderaan, the Windseeker. He treats visitors with aloof indifference unless they carry proof of the Windseeker's shattered essence.

sections.title: The Vessel of Rebirth
sections.body: Demitrian's purpose is tied entirely to Thunderaan's resurrection. Should an adventurer present him with the Bindings of the Windseeker—relics torn from fire elementals within the Molten Core—Demitrian provides the Vessel of Rebirth. He demands rare elemental reagents, including vast quantities of enchanted elementium and the essence of the Firelord, to reconstitute his prince's physical form.

sections.title: Betrayal of the Windseeker
sections.body: Demitrian's ritual brings Prince Thunderaan into the Crystal Vale, where adventurers must face the restored Windseeker in battle. Once they vanquish the elemental lord, they recover the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade and bring it to the terrified Demitrian, who awakens Thunderfury in exchange.

faq.q: Where can I find Highlord Demitrian?
faq.answer: He is located in the far northwestern corner of Silithus, standing near the Ravaged Twilight Camp inside the Crystal Vale.

faq.q: Why does Demitrian only give a generic response?
faq.answer: Demitrian will not offer his legendary quest chain unless you are carrying at least one half of the Bindings of the Windseeker, which are rare treasures held by Baron Geddon and Garr in the Molten Core.

faq.q: What is Demitrian's relationship to Prince Thunderaan?
faq.answer: Demitrian is the sworn mortal servant of Prince Thunderaan. He has dedicated himself to finding the prince's severed bindings and restoring the elemental lord to the physical plane.

faq.q: What happens when you bring him all the materials for the vessel?
aliases: what does demitrian do with the vessel
faq.answer: Demitrian conducts a ritual that calls Prince Thunderaan forth into the Crystal Vale, restoring the Windseeker to the physical plane.

faq.q: Is Demitrian affiliated with the Twilight's Hammer cult?
faq.answer: He is tied to the Twilight's Hammer and dwells in their ravaged camp, and he speaks of the Old Gods with reverence. Still, his sworn devotion is to his master, Prince Thunderaan.

faq.q: How do you get Thunderfury from him?
faq.answer: After Prince Thunderaan is defeated, adventurers recover the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade and present it to Demitrian. He awakens the blade and grants Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker.

angles.text: Demitrian's demands for Thunderaan's rebirth require extensive blacksmithing mastery to forge Enchanted Elementium Bars from raw ore and fiery essences.
Warriors seeking the legendary blade Thunderfury must seek out Demitrian to initiate the trial of unbinding and awakening the Windseeker.
Rogues hunting the legendary blade of the Windseeker must bargain with Demitrian in Silithus to restore the shattered prince.
